hero.label: Our Sector
hero.title: Acquisitions
hero.description: We seek profitable, well-run companies in the Slovak and Czech markets. We offer fair pricing and a discreet process.

intro: We seek established, profitable companies in the Slovak and Czech markets suitable for acquisition. We invest through long-term partnerships with a focus on value growth.

criteria.label: Investment Criteria
criteria.description: We focus on established companies with clear growth potential and a stable team.

turnover.label: Turnover
turnover.text: We look for companies with annual turnover between €1 million and €10 million.

profitability.label: Profitability
profitability.text: The company must have been profitable for at least 2 consecutive years.

market.label: Market
market.text: We focus on the Slovak and Czech markets with expansion potential.

team.label: Team
team.text: We prefer companies with established management and a loyal team.

process.label: How It Works
process.description: From first contact to closing the transaction.

contact.title: Initial Contact
contact.text: A non-binding consultation about your company. We sign an NDA.

dueDiligence.title: Due Diligence
dueDiligence.text: Detailed analysis of financial statements and the business model.

valuation.title: Valuation & Offer
valuation.text: A fair offer based on market valuation.

closing.title: Closing
closing.text: Finalisation of documents and transfer of ownership.
